description: Gefahrenhinweisbereich tiefreichende Rutschungen is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by lfu.bayern.de. Deep slides are downhill movements of rock or loose rock. The speeds of the slipping masses range from a few centimeters per year to several meters per minute. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "Hazard warning area deep slides" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include inspireidentifiziert, opendata, Hangbewegungen, Rutschung, UmweltAtlas, ENVI. The listing shows 3 download or service links in WMS, WFS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
